note: Spec machine du G5 Gate 1 (historique confirmatoire). Seul fichier lu par l'evaluateur. Chaque cle doit etre implementee (requires) ; toute cle inconnue est refusee. Le sha256 de la version FROZEN fait partie du gel (protocole section 13). Amendement A1 du 2026-10-21 (avant tout gel et toute lecture, protocole section Amendement A1) : selection adverse de la jambe d'entree de T01 mesuree par le conditionnement au remplissage (cout T01 9,5 / 14,25 pb, ancien total 13 / 19,5 pb en sensibilite rapportee), tableau A/B/C, analyse des non-remplis, variante preneur, stabilite chronologique, classification diagnostique (rapportes, jamais decisifs), frontieres comptees. Revision 0.4.0-draft (2026-10-22, decision du proprietaire (a) "Finir les controles G5 realisables des maintenant", avant tout gel et toute lecture) : capacite gate2_frozen_together et bloc frozen_with (le run du Gate 1 lit le spec Gate 2 avant toute donnee de marche et refuse de tourner s'il n'est pas FROZEN, garde une valeur owner_decision_pending, un marqueur ou un null, ou si son freeze_fill.gate1_spec_sha256 differe du sha256 de ce fichier ; sha256 du Gate 2 imprime ; Annexe B demande 11) ; test de contenu des calendriers en FROZEN (content_rule, nyse_half_days, content_exceptions, session us_cash_close a 13:00 les demi-seances ; demande 13) ; refus de FROZEN sur le marqueur freeze_pending suivi d un deux-points (demande 14) ; S_eco = 97,25 (D4, GATES 1.2 amende ; seuils de rentabilite recalcules ; demande 16) ; descriptif T01_previous_settlement_filter_only (demande 18).

freeze_fill.rule: toutes ces valeurs sont non nulles dans la version FROZEN ; l'evaluateur refuse un spec FROZEN qui en contient une nulle

universe.rule: liste D1 (29 X-Perps, LP-OWNER-DECISIONS-2026-10-21) intersectee avec la regle de metadonnees du snapshot post-2026-10-31 : instType FUTURES, ruleType xperp, sous-jacent crypto <BASE>-USD, list_time + eligibility.days < end_exclusive_utc ; aucun volume ; aucune valeur de marche
universe.selection_bias_declared: la liste D1 vient d'un volume >= 1 M USD du 2026-10-14 (quarantaine, GATES M11) ; derogation ecrite du proprietaire exigee (P-G5-4)

price.boundary_convention: c(t) = close of the candle opening at t - 60 s

unit.n_definition: number of unique event instants with >= min_instruments_per_instant retained instruments

statistics.difference: D = mean over event instants - mean over control instants

costs.g2_table_substitution: none: G5 is frozen before the G2 reading (P-G5-9), the design values are final

funding.formula: funding_bp = -side * sum(realized rates of the instrument's settlements T with entry < T <= exit) * 1e4

controls_common.rule: same classifier, sign rule, fill proxy, exclusions, costs and funding formula as the events of the type
controls_common.candidates: every hour of the type's control days at controls.minute_of_hour
controls_common.admissible_if: control footprint end <= exclusion start - margin_min or control footprint start >= exclusion end + margin_min, for every exclusion footprint
exclusions: settlements of the instrument read in funding_hist (all intervals), footprint [s-5 ; s+15]
default settlement grid of the type (controls.default_settlement_grid_utc_hours), every day, footprint [s-5 ; s+15]
T05 event instants (generator of T05_us_open), footprint [h ; h+60], for every instrument
controls_common.funding_at_controls: computed; expected 0; any non-zero count reported as anomaly

sessions_note: jours de semaine locaux ; feries locaux (UK, HK, JP) ignores : exclusion appliquee tous les lundis-vendredis (conservateur) ; demi-seances NYSE UNKNOWN, a relever au gel (P-G5-5)

calendars.content_rule: FROZEN only, over R = [T0 ; last scored day + data-gap extension] (Gate 1: the spec window) ; at least one cpi date and one employment_situation date in every calendar month that meets R, unless content_exceptions names that list and that month ; every span of 56 consecutive days inside R holds a fomc_statement date ; the nyse_holidays inside R equal the rule-based NYSE generator (New Year's Day, Martin Luther King Jr. Day = 3rd Monday of January, Washington's Birthday = 3rd Monday of February, Good Friday from Easter, Memorial Day = last Monday of May, Juneteenth, Independence Day, Labor Day = 1st Monday of September, Thanksgiving = 4th Thursday of November, Christmas Day ; a Saturday holiday observed the Friday before except New Year's Day, a Sunday holiday the Monday after) up to the dates content_exceptions adds (extra_closure) or removes (not_observed) ; nyse_half_days listed (each a NYSE trading day ; the sessions with on_nyse_half_days take that time on them, a 13:00 ET close moves the us_cash_close exclusion) ; every exception dated (written_utc) and sourced

macro_filter.use: control exclusion (controls_common.exclusions) ; CPI and employment_situation dates also excluded from T05 events
macro_filter.ten_am_et_releases: declared noise inside the T05 window, not excluded ; descriptive stratum list frozen at P-G5-5

cost_sensitivity_pre_a1.use: reported sensitivity only: C2 / C3 values at the pre-A1 total ; never a criterion

funding_coverage.start: first settlement of funding_hist whose predecessor is also served (manifest coverage_start_us, end_reason required)

classifier.premium_proxy: pi(g) = (m(g) - idx(g)) / idx(g) at minute boundary g, m and idx = closes of mark_1m and index_1m candles ending at g
classifier.weights: k = 1..480, oldest = 1, boundary t_arm = 480 ; renormalised over present minutes
classifier.threshold_origin: |R| >= 4 bp <=> average premium >= +0.09 % or <= -0.09 % (OKX formula, I = 0.01 %, clamp 0.05 %, N = 8)

validation.population: raw T01 instrument-settlements (eligible, interval filter passed, realized rate present, classifier computable)
validation.report: 3x3 matrix (classifier class x rate class), always printed
validation.sensitivity: share of rate class != 0 with classifier class == rate class
validation.false_positive_rate: share of rate class == 0 with classifier class != 0

controls.days: days on which the instrument has >= 1 raw T01 event (before classifier and fill proxy)
days on which the instrument has a raw T05 event

criteria.C4: D point > 0 in each half ; halves = sorted distinct event days of the type cut at the lower median day (first half = days <= median) ; controls of the same days
criteria.C5: LB90(D) > 0 after removing the ceil(0.05 n) event instants with the highest per-instant net ; controls unchanged ; same bootstrap seed and resamples
criteria.C6: T01 only: validation of the classifier (events[].validation)
criteria.C7: T01 only: D point > 0 on the event instants at 16:00 UTC against the controls of the same UTC days

verdict.pass: G5_GATE1_PASS(type) iff every criterion of the type holds and holm_local_confirmed(type)
verdict.fail: G5_GATE1_FAIL(type) otherwise, once no inconclusive condition holds and the floor is met

fail_annotation.ub90_ge_threshold: non poursuivi ; absence d'effet non demontree
fail_annotation.ub90_lt_threshold: effet >= +10 pb exclu sous la forme testee

verdict.closure_scope: the tested form only (type, classifier, window, execution role, threshold) ; never the mechanism

sealing.open_after: G5 Gate 2 verdict of the same type

economic.fills_per_day: admitted filled orders / number of days of the type's calendar (T01: calendar days of funding_coverage ; T05: NYSE trading days of the window with >= 1 eligible instrument, macro days included in the denominator)
economic.measure: absolute event net_bp (round trip), never D
economic.pursued_if: point >= s_eco and (ub90 >= 2 * s_eco or lb90 > 0)

descriptive.rule: aucun descriptif ne recoit de p-value ni de verdict ; jamais promu ; un filtre G5 qui entre dans un protocole gele apres cette lecture y compte p = 1 (post-screen, GATES 2.1)

a1.status: amendment A1 (2026-10-21), written before any freeze and any reading ; reported, never decisive, never a verdict

definitions.A_signal: gross signed return of the reference price over return_window_min at every classified instrument-instant (classifier or sign passed, fill proxy off) ; no funding, no cost
definitions.B_execution: the same gross return at the instrument-instants retained by the primary measure (filled by the fill proxy ; a taker entry is filled by construction)
definitions.C_net: the primary net_bp = B + funding - the costs of the type (events[].expected_cost_bp) ; with the portfolio reading
definitions.statistics: per row (events, controls, events - controls): n instants, n instrument-instants, fill rate, mean, median, LB90 and UB90 of the day-block bootstrap of the statistics block ; no p-value
definitions.filled_vs_unfilled: A at the filled against A at the unfilled classified instrument-instants, events and controls (instant means), gap = filled - unfilled ; fill rates of the events and of the controls
definitions.taker_variant: taker entry at c(t_arm) plus costs.taker_entry_half_spread_bp, no fill conditioning, costs of the taker_maker role, same funding, same exit
definitions.chronological_stability: D and n per calendar month (UTC) and per half of the type's window (calendar days, first half = the first floor(L / 2) days), for C (net_bp) and A

classification_rules.d_insufficiently_documented: verdict NOT_INFORMATIVE or INCONCLUSIVE, or n below power_floor, or no LB90 / UB90 for A_event - A_control, or LB90(A_event - A_control) <= 0 and UB90(A_event - A_control) >= threshold_bp
classification_rules.c_badly_executed: LB90(A_event - A_control) > 0, the type has a fill proxy, UB90(A_filled - A_unfilled at the events) < 0, mean B_event < mean A_event, mean C_event <= 0 and mean taker-variant net at the events > 0

frozen_with.rule: both specs are frozen in the same freeze line (protocol section 13 point 5) ; before any market read the Gate 1 evaluator reads frozen_with.spec (or --gate2-spec) and refuses to run (refuse_run) unless it is FROZEN, holds no owner_decision_pending, no freeze_pending marker and no null, passes the strict Gate 2 reader against this Gate 1 spec and its freeze_fill.gate1_spec_sha256 equals the sha256 of the Gate 1 spec read ; the sha256 of the Gate 2 spec is printed in the Gate 1 output (capability gate2_frozen_together)

pre_freeze.sealed: per-instrument manifest (rows, oldest/newest, pages), segment sha256

fetch_plan.max_requests: set by the owner's decision P-G5-1 ; the fetcher refuses a plan above it
